en: Prof. Kukui
Welcome to Iki Town! This is where the island's festival is held, right on that stage.
text: Bun venit în Iki Town! Aici se ține festivalul insulei, chiar pe scena aceea.

en: Bad news, though: the kahuna's gone off somewhere. He does that. He's a busy man.
text: Vești proaste, însă: kahuna a plecat undeva. Face asta. E un om ocupat.

en: Oh, and a girl I know just ran up the Mahalo Trail, north of the village, in an awful hurry. Would you go and check on her for me?
text: Ah, și o fată pe care o cunosc tocmai a urcat în goană pe Poteca Mahalo, la nord de sat, grăbită îngrozitor. Ai putea s-o verifici pentru mine?

en: Hala
Ho ho! So you're the new face Kukui told me about. And it seems the island's guardian has taken an interest in you as well!
text: Ho ho! Deci tu ești chipul nou despre care mi-a vorbit Kukui. Și se pare că ocrotitorul insulei s-a interesat și el de tine!

en: Prof. Kukui
Hala's the kahuna of Melemele, the one who watches over the whole island. Kahuna, this is {player}.
text: Hala e kahuna din Melemele, cel care veghează asupra întregii insule. Kahuna, ți-l prezint pe {player}.

en: Hala
Every child in Alola goes out into the world with a partner. Here are three who have been waiting. Choose the one you like!
text: Fiecare copil din Alola pornește în lume cu un partener. Iată trei care te-au așteptat. Alege-l pe cel care îți place!

en: {player} chose {starter}!
Hala
A fine choice. May the two of you grow strong together.
text: O alegere bună. Fie ca voi doi să deveniți puternici împreună.

en: Hau
Tutu! Wait for me! Did I miss it?
Alola! I'm Hau. That's my grandpa, the kahuna! You got your Pokémon already? Then this one's mine!
text: Alola! Sunt Hau. Ăla e bunicul meu, kahuna! Ți-ai primit deja Pokémonul? Atunci pe ăsta îl iau eu!

en: Hala
You were off eating again, weren't you? Very well, very well.
text: Iar ai fost la mâncat, nu-i așa? Bine, bine.

en: Hau
Hey, {player}! We've both got Pokémon now, so let's battle! The first battle's the best one!
text: Hei, {player}! Acum avem amândoi Pokémoni, deci hai să ne luptăm! Prima luptă e cea mai frumoasă!

en: Hau
Aw, you're really good! That was so much fun. Your Pokémon looked like it was having fun too!
text: Of, ești foarte bun! Ce distracție a fost! Pokémonul tău părea că se distrează și el!

en: We won! But that was so close. Let's battle again sometime, okay?
text: Am câștigat! Dar a fost la mustață. Hai să ne luptăm din nou cândva, bine?

en: Prof. Kukui
Woo! What a battle! Now, {player}, come by my laboratory on the beach south of your house. I've got something for you.
text: Uuu! Ce luptă! Acum, {player}, treci pe la laboratorul meu de pe plajă, la sud de casa ta. Am ceva pentru tine.

en: Prof. Kukui
The kahuna might be back soon. Have a look around the village while you wait.
text: Kahuna s-ar putea întoarce curând. Uită-te prin sat cât aștepți.

en: Hala
The island watches over all of us, and the guardian watches over the island. Take good care of your partner.
text: Insula veghează asupra noastră, a tuturor, iar ocrotitorul veghează asupra insulei. Ai grijă de partenerul tău.

en: Pass Ilima's trial, and every captain's on Melemele that follows, and I will be waiting for you on this stage for your grand trial.
Ho ho! Akala's kahuna is a fierce one. Show her the same fire you showed me.
Hau
Have you tried the malasadas in Hau'oli City? They're the best thing in Alola! Well, after Pokémon.
text: Ai gustat malasada din Hau'oli City? Sunt cel mai bun lucru din Alola! Ei bine, după Pokémoni.

en: Hala
Ah, there you are! Tonight we hold the festival for Tapu Koko, the guardian of Melemele.
And in Iki Town, a festival is never complete without a battle on the stage. Hau has been waiting all day!
Hau
Finally! I've been practising with my new Pokémon. And I caught a new friend too! Let's give the guardian a good show!
Hau
Whoa, you got even stronger since this morning! The guardian must have liked that one.
We did it! But only just. That was the best festival battle ever!
Hala
A fine battle, both of you. Tapu Koko is surely pleased.
{player}, the guardian took an interest in you on the bridge. So I give you this, for the island challenge.
Pass the trials of the island's captains, and the crystals they give you will let you and your Pokémon unleash Z-Moves through that ring.
Your first trial is Captain Ilima's, in Verdant Cavern at the end of Route 2. Go with the guardian's blessing!
Hau
I'll go on ahead to Route 2! See you there, {player}!
Hala
Ho ho! Ilima's crystal, and the look of a Trainer who has walked every road of Melemele. Then the time has come.
I am Hala, kahuna of this island. As kahuna, I will face you with everything I have. Show me the strength you have found!
Hala
Ha! Splendid, splendid! The guardian chose well.
{player}'s Trainer card received Melemele's stamp!
And take this, too. With it, the Tauros of the island will come when you call.
{player} registered Tauros in the Ride Pager! Tauros can charge through cracked rocks.
Kukui is waiting at Hau'oli's marina with his boat. Akala Island is next, and its kahuna will not go easy on you!
